about.bio:
I'm a Physicist who always like to code and then decide to work with IT, first becoming a web developer and now working with data, People Analytics to be more specific.

Throughout my education, I have worked for more than four years in research laboratories with interdisciplinary subjects (Microfluidics, Composite Polymers and Sensors) and taught Physics and Mathematics for more than two years. These experiences allowed me to develop the ability to analyze, propose and adapt solutions to the most diverse situations.

I'm currently working as Data Engineer.
